posts.name: Lateralis
posts.cooked:
Hello fellow Sentinels Fans! As you know, Handelabra Games is hard at work on the iPad and Android tablet version of Sentinels of the Multiverse. Because we love the game as much as you do, we’d love to hear some feedback on our first prototype!

We’re putting up a demo video to get some feedback from fans who know the game and are likely to play the digital version once it’s released. We are not looking for wide media coverage at this point and this is a non-public video. Please only share the link with folks you think might be interested in giving feedback.

As far as feedback, we’d like to hear anything and everything. What you like, what you don’t, what’s missing, etc. This is a first prototype/proof of concept so treat it as such; it is not necessarily representative of the final product.

Below you’ll find the link to the non-public YouTube video showing the progression of a single turn. It’s the Freedom 5 vs Baron Blade at Megalopolis!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YdPkln6fnyc


We’re happy to answer any questions you may have here in the thread, or you can send us feedback directly from here. Please understand that there may be some topics where we say “we’re not talking about that just yet.” It’s nothing personal!

Thanks!

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Will there be any crossover with Sidekick?

For example, if I own the card game and sidekick, and a friend of mine owns the digital version, would we be able to play together?

 

I would really like that, because I don't like having programs shuffle cards or roll dice for me.  I tend to dislike electronic card games because of that.  If I could do my own cards and input them and have that work with this game I think that would be super cool.

Don't know how feasible that would be, just curious.

 

As for the demo, it looks super cool.  If the background was due to it being in Megalopolis (I assume so) I love that touch.

Will the game automatically resolve timing conflicts, or have the players choose?

Lastly I'd like to call Shenanigans on Wraith just playing Razor Ordinance with Impromptu Invention in her hand.  What was she thinking?

 

OK, real last question:  Do you plan on having decks be playable by AI?  I would think that would be really tricky with all the nuances and combo's possible.

Also if you have multiple players playing on different devices and Visionary puts Twist the Ether on someone would the target of Twist the Ether get to choose the damage type and amount, or Visionary?

That last question is not serious.  We all know Visionary gets to choose.

Your video was awesome and I think you are doing great.  Any chance that this will be shown or on demo at Pax East?

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
Ronway:

On a more important note, I noticed both Play and use a Power phases had a skip option, where the Draw phase did not. Did I miss something or is it not in there yet?

It's not in there yet, but good catch. This prototype demo is not a complete representation of what the game will be, but a snapshot of the direction we're going in terms of UI and flow. Skipping the draw is an interesting one - you almost always want to draw, but there are cases where you definitely don't want to. Ideally we'll streamline it so that you only get presented with a skip option if it could make reasonable sense to want one; otherwise you just get your card and the game moves on. Of course that would be configurable, in case you're the kind of player who wants complete control.
